defects.description: The word "замечания" is used to translate the English concept of "value" (each outcome value), which changes the meaning.
Code token `no-Консенсус` does not match the source token `no-consensus`.
Code token `no_Консенсус` does not match the source token `no_consensus`.
Code token `blocked-Эскалация` does not match the source token `blocked-escalation`.
Glossary term "Phase" is translated inside the identifier `фаза_state` instead of keeping the original term `phase_state`.
